name: comp-252
title: Volume Slider
description: A sound-level setting inside a dark card. A muted speaker, a horizontal level slider and a loud speaker sit on one row, with the current level printed beside the heading.
use: A settings panel or player needs a readable sound level with the current number in view.
avoid: The two speaker icons are decoration only, so there is no working mute toggle here.
a11y: The slider is labelled for screen readers, but the speaker icons are hidden from assistive tech and the number is not tied to the slider. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered dark card holds a small heading with a grey helper line, then a row with the word Volume on the left and a number on the right. Beneath it a muted speaker icon, a grey track with a round white knob, and a speaker icon at the far end.
behaves: Sliding the knob right lengthens the white filled portion and raises the number beside Volume. The knob gains a soft ring while it is being dragged and everything settles in place on release.
customise: The Volume label and the starting level are written in the source; the icons and number layout need edits to change.
weight: light: A card, one track and a couple of icons; nothing runs until the knob is dragged.
